# rag-pipeline-yaml

> Declarative RAG pipelines in YAML: registered components, typed variable interpolation, static checks before any step runs, alias-free safe loading and content-free traces Python package `trysac-rag-pipeline-yaml`, import name `rag_pipeline_yaml`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
